cohort: The study included 28,252 infants born between 24 and 28 weeks of gestational age in the California Perinatal Quality Care Collaborative between 2005 and 2016.
finding: As the proportion of antenatal steroid use in the population increased from 2005 to 2016, the observed positive effect of antenatal steroids on neonatal death and severe IVH also increased, indicating a "population improvement bias" because outcomes improved significantly only in exposed infants, who had a lower risk profile.
